purpose: Treat one alternative as tolerable compared with a worse one.
keywords: N / plain clause + ならまだしも
Ten minutes might be tolerable, but I cannot wait an hour.
It might be understandable for a child, but an adult needs to know.
Rain might be manageable, but I cannot cycle in snow.
formation: N / plain clause + ならまだしも
restrictions: The second situation is usually judged unacceptable or surprising.
mistake: Do not read it as approval of the first situation.
